Hawaii Vacation Packing List

Based on your itinerary from June 10-20, 2024:

Essential Items:
- Swimwear (for beach days at Waikiki and Kailua, snorkeling at Hanauma Bay)
- Sunscreen (high SPF recommended for Hawaii sun)
- Hiking gear (for Diamond Head hike on June 13)
- Casual outfits (for daily activities and luau on June 16)
- Camera (to capture memories at Pearl Harbor, North Shore, etc.)
- Travel documents (passport/ID, flight information, hotel reservations)

Additional Recommended Items:
- Light jacket or sweater (for cooler evenings)
- Rain jacket or umbrella (for potential showers)
- Comfortable walking shoes (for sightseeing and hiking)
- Water shoes (for beach and snorkeling activities)
- Reusable water bottle
- Snorkeling gear (if not renting at Hanauma Bay)
- Beach towel
- Insect repellent
- Medications and first aid supplies
- Phone charger and travel adapter
- Cash and credit cards

Special Items for Specific Activities:
- June 13 (Diamond Head Hike): Sturdy hiking shoes, hat, plenty of water
- June 14 (Pearl Harbor): Respectful attire, photo ID
- June 16 (Luau): Hawaiian shirt or dress (aloha attire)
- June 18 (Kayaking): Quick-dry clothing, waterproof bag for valuables
